articleTitle: 8-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) using full swing restored M-GDI technique
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: The ALU is an essential operational unit found in every processor, serving as the core component of the CPU. It performs most of the fundamental operations, including logical and arithmetic operations. In this paper, an 8-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) is developed using swing restored M-GDI technique and compared with the previous M-GDI technique. The M-GDI technique is area and power efficient technology but the output swing is not obtained fully. To solve this problem a swing restored M-GDI technique applied to previous circuits. The ALU is responsible for performing logic operations (AND, OR, XOR) and arithmetic operations (ADDER, SUBTRACTOR, MAGNITUDE COMPARTOR) using three logic gates: AND, OR, and XOR. The output of the ALU is determined by the input select line and given to the multiplexer. The average power, number of transistors, and delay are the key factors used to evaluate the performance of the ALU, which is implemented in the software CADENCE VIRTUOSO.

articleTitle: Spyonian 300 6WD-the dark spy worker voice controlled robot using arduino
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: The goal of our project is to create a voice-controlled robot car. A Bluetooth module, motor drivers and an Arduino microcontroller are used in the operation., Arduino hardware is a user free platform for creating digital devices. The plan is to initially design the Robot Car's hardware before using our prior programming experience to develop the entire system. The software (IDE) will then simulate the code before allowing it to connect with the hardware. Using a Bluetooth module to record and read the spoken commands, the control unit and Bluetooth device are coordinated. A smart Android device with a Bluetooth application serves as the controlling remote. We chose this as our project since robots has a significant impact on our way of life and has a broad application in engineering. It is crucial to the advancement of new technology.

publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: A system known as a brain-computer interface (BCI) converts human brainwaves into signals or instructions that can be used to interact with the exterior environment. This type of interaction does not need any skeletal or other movements. Brain wave sensors are used for the collection of Brain signals from the human Subject. Here, we classify the signal and extract features using a Raspberry Pi, where NumPy is used in the project for programming. This is a project which takes the initiative to make life much easier for those who are impaired and disabled. The goal of the project is to create a BCI-based system for controlling various gadgets at home.

articleTitle: Study on recent approaches of power optimization techniques in VLSI design
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: The performance and efficiency of the integrated circuit are impacted by power optimization, making it a crucial component in VLSI design. The operational expenses, battery life, and environmental effect of electronic devices are all impacted by power consumption, which is a crucial factor in VLSI design. The majority of recent research concentrate on simulations or laboratory trials, which could not truly reflect the difficulties and limitations of actual IoT implementations. Large-scale field tests of IoT devices using various power management techniques may be used in future studies to provide more accurate assessment of their efficacy and viability. This literature study paves stone to further research works in power optimization in VLSI circuits.

articleTitle: Modelling of thermal effect in through-silicon via for 3D IC
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: A model Through-silicon via (TSV) can be designed by COMSOL CAD. By using Prime parameters related to the temperature, the study can be carried out to look into the issues with heat transient forming across TSV. The Thermal effect is considered the pivotal as it affects the overall internal dynamics within TSV. Here the work focuses on developing an axisymmetric Transient heat transfer modelling across the structure. In this work, the TSV structure and its performance based on heat transient are observed for the design taking into consideration the constraints of size of TSV.

articleTitle: Study and analysis of COVID 19 spread in India using SIRD model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: COVID-19 has already been declared as a global pandemic by WHO. The rate at which this disease is spreading is very much worrying. Many factors affect the spread of a disease, but predictions can be made regarding the trend a disease would follow. A mathematical model Susceptible-Infected-Recovered-Dead (SIRD) has been used to predict the COVID-19 spread in India. The time frame that was analyzed for the prediction is from 30th January 2020 to 16th May 2020. Using the existing data the estimation of the date till which the active infected cases will be at its peak has been done, after hitting the peak the infected cases would start to come down significantly. According to this study there are two cases that are most likely to happen, both have been analyzed thoroughly. In the first case analysis has been done and the minimum active infected cases are predicted to be around 1,30,000 and in the second case the maximum number of cases are expected to be 1,89,000 during the peak of the COVID-19 spread that is predicted to be from 8th June 2020 to 25th June 2020. To support the accuracy of the estimation of the SIRD model, analysis has been done for the COVID-19 situation in China and the output of the model has been compared with actual data available for the country. SARS 2003 pandemic has also been analyzed to understand the trend of spread of a viral disease according to the SIRD model.

articleTitle: Design of a 17×17 signed Vedic multiplier for FFT
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: The major component of a processor is a multiplier. An energy efficient processor is need of the hour. Vedic multipliers are power and area efficient multipliers and hence in this work vedic multiplier is proposed. Since for FFT calculations signed multipliers are required, the proposed work represents a signed 17×17 Vedic Multiplier of the Urdhva Tiryak type designed using an unsigned multiplier. Post Implementation, the report power, the utilization summary and the waveform are generated and results are analyzed for efficiency. An efficient 17 bit multiplier is the result. Percentage utilization of LUT's is less than 1% which indicates the scope of device optimization, for specific purpose usage.

articleTitle: A new MPPT technique for PV systems under partially shaded conditions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: An empirical maximum power point algorithm for photovoltaic systems is presented in this research. It is challenging to determine the running voltage proportionate to maximum power point changes with alteration in solar irradiance and temperature in photo voltaic systems owing to the non linearity of the voltage-current characteristics, especially in the case of partial shading conditions. This method calculates the voltage at the peak power point in accordance with the local climate. The operating point is subsequently driven to the global peak power point using voltage tracking. This approach is straightforward and requires fewer sensors.

articleTitle: Railway track crack detection using robot
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: To ensure public safety, railroad transportation needs to be constantly inspected and promptly maintained. Traditional manual inspections are expensive and time-consuming, but the accuracy of flaw identification depends on the inspector's skill and productivity. Railway track inspection using robots is an innovative technology that has revolutionized the way railway tracks are inspected. It involves the use of autonomous robots that are designed to inspect and monitor railway tracks. The robots are equipped with ultrasonic sensors that enable them to detect any kind of defect or damage to the tracks. They are programmed to move along the track and detect potential defects or damages. This technology has improved the safety standards of railway tracks by helping the operators to detect and repair any defects in a timely manner. It has also helped reduce the need for manual track inspection, thus reducing the costs associated with it. Furthermore, the use of robots for track inspection has also helped in reducing the risk of human error during the inspection process.

articleTitle: Poly saccharide assisted exfoliation of graphite towards highly conductive graphene nano ink for biocompatible sensors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: Graphene, and graphene nanoparticles are progressively attracting universal attention because of their appealing properties. This paper presents a greener method of producing highly conductive graphene nano ink from graphite. The exfoliation is assisted by naturally available polysaccharide -Gum Arabic. The Paper electrode system was made by using the above ink and the sensitivity was measured using CV characterization. It was found that the ink is highly conductive and has better cyclic voltammogram characteristics compared to the commercially available paper electrodes. The electrode was also modified by golden nanoparticles to check the modifiability. It was found that the characteristics were improving upon modification with metallic nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Retinal image enhancement based on illumination component and gamma correction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: Majority of the human eye diseases like Diabetes Retinopathy, Glaucoma and Age related macular Edema(AMD) can be diagnosed by analysing the retinal images. But the non-uniform illumination, low contrast and noise in the images causes difficulty in the diagnosis. In the proposed method the calculated illumination component of the image is subjected to Gamma correction to suppress un-even illumination. The proposed method performed better compared to similar algorithms in terms of various performance indicators and also gave sharper images without affecting its natural appearance.

articleTitle: Dual-axis solar tracking system with LDR sensors
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: In recent times, the usage of photovoltaic (PV) cells is the various energy generation strategies that take in sun energy and convert it into electric energy. The solar movements from east to west in the course of the day and its radiation angle adjustments relative to the motion of earth in various seasons. So, the output electricity of PV panels changes as well. The output strength of PV panels increases with the aid of being positioned in a role perpendicular to the perspective of the solar's rays. This paper aims to layout and put into effect a dual-axis solar tracker to increase the output power of the PV panel. This device has excessive performance and adjusts the PV panel primarily based on sun radiation through transferring simultaneously on axes. An analog controller is used for its manage device. DAST manipulate gadget is a closed-loop device that makes use of Wheatstone bridge circuit feature in conjunction with mild-based resistors. A small DAST turned into designed and constructed to validate the proposed device, the overall performance of which changed into demonstrated. Based totally on the experiments, I-V and P-V specifications have been obtained. Finally, it turned into found that the output energy of the PV panel the use of solar tracker became higher than that of the constant panel.

articleTitle: A comprehensive review energy efficient wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Communication, Embedded-VLSI Systems for Electric Vehicle (ICCEVE 2023)
abstract: In recent years, both the research community and end users have initiated to give more attention to wireless sensor networks (WSNs). WSNs are spatially dispersed networks with a large number of nodes that can monitor and record a variety of ecological conditions including humidity, temperature, pressure and lightning conditions. As a result of recent developments in advanced data transmission, the deployment of WSNs has substantially improved. A number of real-world issues can be solved at low cost using wireless sensor networks. Energy efficiency is the main criteria for routing protocol design for the wireless sensor networks since the life-time of the systems depends on the durability of each sensor node. The small sensor node in a WSN runs on a very small battery that has a limited amount of energy. It is not possible to change the battery or recharge the battery. So, the crucial factor is how energy-efficiently WSN operates. This article provides a brief overview of various secure and energy-efficient routing protocols including LEACH, PEGASIS, SEP, DDEEC, EESAA, IAATPC, and EESCA for wireless sensor networks.
